gle exceptions · Premium")
                end
            end
        end
        function K.SetScope(id)
            K.ED.scope = id
            local e = id and FS.RegById[id]
            local name = e and GetText(e.ES, e.EN) or GetText("Vuelo", "Fly")
            if K.samples[1] then K.samples[1].SetText(name) end
            if K.samples[2] then K.samples[2].SetText(name) end
            K.RefreshAll()
            K.changed()
            if id then
                K.setStatus("Editando la excepción de \"" .. (e and e.ES or id) .. "\": lo que cambies pisa al global solo ahí", "Editing \"" .. (e and e.EN or id) .. "\": changes override the global design only there", Theme.Accent)
            end
        end
        K.globalBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() K.SetScope(nil) end)
        K.scopeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            if not FS.HasPremium() then K.showPremium() return end
            K.openScopeSheet()
        end)
        K.dropBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            local id = K.ED.scope
            if not id then return end
            K.ED.O[id] = nil
            K.SetScope(nil)
            K.setStatus("Excepción quitada: ese toggle vuelve a usar el diseño global", "Exception removed: that toggle uses the global design again", Theme.Accent)
        end)

        local UI = {}
        local function close()
            K.open = false
            K.flip = false
            K.activeSlider = nil
            if K.closePicker then pcall(K.closePicker, false) end
            if K.liveReal then
                K.liveReal = false
                FS.LiveResolver = nil
                FS.ApplyAll()
            end
            TweenService:Create(PanelScale, TweenInfo.new(0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), { Scale = 0.94 }):Play()
            task.delay(0.15, function() Overlay.Visible = false end)
        end
        closeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(close)
        cancelBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(close)
        saveBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            FS.Data.Global = FS.Sanitize(K.ED.G, false)
            local ov = {}
            for id, t in pairs(K.ED.O) do
                local s = FS.Sanitize(t, true)
                if next(s) then ov[id] = s end
            end
            FS.Data.Overrides = ov
            local ok = FS.Save()
            playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.6)
            K.liveReal = false
            FS.LiveResolver = nil
            FS.ApplyAll()
            if FS.RefreshEntry then FS.RefreshEntry() end
            if not ok then
                warn("[YinYang Estudio de Toggles] Tu ejecutor no tiene writefile: el diseño dura hasta que cierres el juego")
            end
            close()
        end)

        function UI.Open()
            K.ED = { G = FS.Copy(FS.Data.Global), O = FS.Copy(FS.Data.Overrides), scope = nil }
            K.open = true
            K.flip = false
            Status.Text = ""
            K.stateChips.Set("off")
            K.backChips.Set(K.backdrop or "dark")
            for _, S in ipairs(K.samples) do S.State = false end
            K.setLive(false)
            K.SetScope(nil)
            Content.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, 0)
            Overlay.Visible = true
            PanelScale.Scale = 0.94
            TweenService:Create(PanelScale, TweenInfo.new(0.28, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Scale = 1 }):Play()
        end
        UI.Close = close
        UI.K = K
        return UI
    end
end

ThemePalettes["PibbleV1"] = ThemePalettes["PibbleV1"] or {
    Background = Color3.fromRGB(58, 63, 70),
    Secondary = Color3.fromRGB(88, 93, 100),
    AccentOff = Color3.fromRGB(118, 123, 128),
    Text = Color3.fromRGB(250, 248, 245),
    TextDim = Color3.fromRGB(200, 195, 190),
    Stroke = Color3.fromRGB(228, 180, 190),
    Accent = Color3.fromRGB(240, 200, 210),
    ToggleOn = Color3.fromRGB(255, 210, 220),
}

local function swapThemeColor(obj, palette)
    local bgRole = obj:GetAttribute("ThemeRole")
    if bgRole and palette[bgRole] then
        if obj:IsA("UIStroke") then
            obj.Color = palette[bgRole]
        elseif obj:IsA("GuiObject") then
            pcall(function() obj.BackgroundColor3 = palette[bgRole] end)
        end
    end

    local textRole = obj:GetAttribute("ThemeTextRole")
    if textRole and palette[textRole] then
        if obj:IsA("TextLabel") or obj:IsA("TextButton") or obj:IsA("TextBox") then
            obj.TextColor3 = palette[textRole]
        end
    end

    local textStrokeRole = obj:GetAttribute("ThemeTextStrokeRole")
    if textStrokeRole and palette[textStrokeRole] then
        if obj:IsA("TextLabel") or obj:IsA("TextButton") or obj:IsA("TextBox") then
            pcall(function() obj.TextStrokeColor3 = palette[textStrokeRole] end)
        end
    end

    local imageRole = obj:GetAttribute("ThemeImageRole")
    if imageRole and palette[imageRole] then
        if obj:IsA("ImageLabel") or obj:IsA("ImageButton") then
            obj.ImageColor3 = palette[imageRole]
        end
    end
end

ThemePalettes["ShylfieV1"] = ThemePalettes["ShylfieV1"] or {
    Background = Color3.fromRGB(35, 40, 28),
    Secondary = Color3.fromRGB(58, 65, 42),
    AccentOff = Color3.fromRGB(85, 90, 58),
    Text = Color3.fromRGB(250, 245, 230),
    TextDim = Color3.fromRGB(200, 190, 155),
    Stroke = Color3.fromRGB(180, 165, 115),
    Accent = Color3.fromRGB(230, 195, 130),
    ToggleOn = Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 145),
}

local function setActiveTheme(name)
    local palette = ThemePalettes[name]
    if not palette then return false end
    Theme = table.clone(palette)
    Theme.AccentText = getContrastColor(Theme.Accent)
    Theme.TextStroke = getContrastColor(Theme.Text)
    Theme.ThemeName = name
    Theme.SliderTrack = Theme.SliderTrack or Theme.AccentOff
    Theme.SliderFill = Theme.SliderFill or Theme.Accent
    Theme.SliderThumb = Theme.SliderThumb or Theme.Accent
    Theme.Border = Theme.Border or Theme.Accent
    Theme.TabActive = Theme.TabActive or Color3.fromRGB(225, 100, 0)
    local function lighten(c)
        local h, sat, val = Color3.toHSV(c)
        return Color3.fromHSV(h, math.max(0, sat - 0.3), math.min(1, val + 0.25))
    end
    Theme.BorderLight = Theme.BorderLight or lighten(Theme.Border)
    Theme.TitleText = Theme.TitleText or Theme.Accent
    Theme.SubText = Theme.SubText or Theme.Accent
    Theme.Counter = Theme.Counter or Theme.Accent
    Theme.WindowIcon = Theme.WindowIcon or Theme.Text
    Theme.PillBackground = Theme.PillBackground or Theme.AccentOff
    Theme.PillBorder = Theme.PillBorder or Theme.Accent
    Theme.PillBorderAlt = Theme.PillBorderAlt or lighten(Theme.PillBorder)
    local extras = ThemeExtras[name]
    Theme.WindowIcons = extras and extras.WindowIcons or {}
    Theme.IconSizes = extras and extras.IconSizes or {}
    Theme.TransparentTabs = extras and extras.TransparentTabs == true or false
    Theme.FullBackground = (name == "Navidad") -- exclusivo de Navidad: el fondo cubre toda la ventana
    return true
end

    IconCatalog.Icons["ClassicYinYang"] = {
        LabelES = "Yin Yang Clásico",
        LabelEN = "Classic Yin Yang",
        Layers = {
            { Image = "rbxassetid://106130066496682", Movement = "None" },
            { Image = "rbxassetid://70721341917757",  Movement = "Spin", Speed = 60, Direction = 1, Style = "Organic" },
        },
        IdleSound = { Id = "", Interval = 15, Volume = 0.15 },
    }
end

-- ==================== LOGOS PROPIOS (Estudio de logos, pestaña Logo) ====================
-- Cada logo creado por el usuario se guarda en yin_yang_custom_logos.json y se registra en
-- IconCatalog.Icons["Custom:<id>"] con el mismo formato del catálogo (Layers / sonidos / NoBackground),
-- así ApplyLogoIcon lo dibuja con el mismo motor que los íconos oficiales.
do
    local C = { File = "yin_yang_custom_logos.json", Logos = {}, Order = {}, Max = 30, Prefix = "YYLOGO1:" }
    IconCatalog.Custom = C
    C.Moves = { None = true, Spin = true, Pulse = true, Orbit = true, Float = true, Shake = true, Fade = true }

    local function num(v, lo, hi, def)
        v = tonumber(v)
        if not v or v ~= v then return def end
        return math.clamp(v, lo, hi)
    end
    local function rgb(v)
        if type(v) ~= "table" then return nil end
        local c = arrayToColor(v, nil)
        return c and colorToArray(c) or nil
    end

    -- Acepta un número, rbxassetid://N, un link de Roblox o rbxthumb:// (miniatura)
    function C.CleanAsset(v)
        v = tostring(v or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
        if v == "" then return "" end
        if v:sub(1, 11) == "rbxthumb://" then return v end
        local id = v:match("(%d+)")
        return id and ("rbxassetid://" .. id) or ""
    end

    -- os.time + contador + azar: dos logos creados en el mismo segundo no comparten ID
    C.Seq = 0
    function C.NewId()
        C.Seq += 1
        local id
        repeat
            id = "L" .. tostring(os.time()) .. "_" .. C.Seq .. "_" .. tostring(math.random(100, 999))
        until C.Logos[id] == nil
        return id
    end

    -- Deja solo campos conocidos y valores dentro de rango (sirve para el archivo y para importar códigos)
    function C.Sanitize(s)
        if type(s) ~= "table" or type(s.Layers) ~= "table" then return nil end
        local id = type(s.Id) == "string" and s.Id:match("^[%w_]+$") and s.Id or C.NewId()
        local name = tostring(s.Name or ""):gsub("[%c]", ""):sub(1, 24)
        if name:match("^%s*$") then name = "Mi logo" end
        local out = {
            Id = id,
            Name = name,
            NoBackground = s.NoBackground == true,
            BgColor = rgb(s.BgColor),
            BorderColor = rgb(s.BorderColor),
            Created = tonumber(s.Created) or os.time(),
            Layers = {},
        }
        for i = 1, math.min(#s.Layers, 3) do
            local L = s.Layers[i]
            if type(L) == "table" then
                local img = C.CleanAsset(L.Image)
                if img ~= "" then
                    table.insert(out.Layers, {
                        Image = img,
                        Movement = C.Moves[L.Movement] and L.Movement or "None",
                        Speed = num(L.Speed, 0.1, 2000, 60),
                        Amount = num(L.Amount, 0, 100, 0),
                        Direction = tonumber(L.Direction) == -1 and -1 or 1,
                        Style = L.Style == "Constant" and "Constant" or "Organic",
                        Scale = num(L.Scale, 0.3, 5, 1.6),
                        Transparency = num(L.Transparency, 0, 0.95, 0),
                        Color = rgb(L.Color),
                    })
                end
            end
        end
        if #out.Layers == 0 then return nil end
        if type(s.ClickSound) == "table" then
            local sid = C.CleanAsset(s.ClickSound.Id)
            if sid ~= "" then
                out.ClickSound = { Id = sid, Volume = num(s.ClickSound.Volume, 0, 1, 0.6) }
            end
        end
        if type(s.IdleSound) == "table" then
            local sid = C.CleanAsset(s.IdleSound.Id)
            if sid ~= "" then
                out.IdleSound = { Id = sid, Interval = num(s.IdleSound.Interval, 3, 120, 15), Volume = num(s.IdleSound.Volume, 0, 1, 0.15) }
            end
        end
        return out
    end

    function C.Key(id)
        return "Custom:" .. tostring(id)
    end

    -- Registro guardado -> entrada del catálogo (colores como Color3, igual que lee ApplyLogoIcon)
    function C.ToIcon(rec)
        local icon = {
            LabelES = rec.Name,
            LabelEN = rec.Name,
            Custom = true,
            CustomId = rec.Id,
            NoBackground = rec.NoBackground == true,
            BgColor = rec.BgColor and arrayToColor(rec.BgColor, nil) or nil,
            BorderColor = rec.BorderColor and arrayToColor(rec.BorderColor, nil) or nil,
            Layers = {},
        }
        for i, L in ipairs(rec.Layers) do
            local layer = table.clone(L)
            layer.Color = L.Color and arrayToColor(L.Color, nil) or nil
            icon.Layers[i] = layer
        end
        if rec.ClickSound then icon.ClickSound = table.clone(rec.ClickSound) end
        if rec.IdleSound then icon.IdleSound = table.clone(rec.IdleSound) end
        return icon
    end

    function C.Register(rec)
        IconCatalog.Icons[C.Key(rec.Id)] = C.ToIcon(rec)
    end

    function C.Save()
        local ok = false
        pcall(function()
            if writefile then
                writefile(C.File, HttpService:JSONEncode({ Version = 1, Logos = C.Logos, Order = C.Order }))
                ok = true
            end
        end)
        return ok
    end

    function C.Load()
        if not (readfile and isfile) then return end
        pcall(function()
            if not isfile(C.File) then return end
            local decoded = HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(C.File))
            if type(decoded) ~= "table" or type(decoded.Logos) ~= "table" then return end
            local seen = {}
            local function take(id)
                local rec = C.Sanitize(decoded.Logos[id])
                if rec and not seen[rec.Id] then
                    seen[rec.Id] = true
                    C.Logos[rec.Id] = rec
                    table.insert(C.Order, rec.Id)
                    C.Register(rec)
                end
            end
            for _, id in ipairs(type(decoded.Order) == "table" and decoded.Order or {}) do
                if type(id) == "string" and decoded.Logos[id] then take(id) end
            end
            for id in pairs(decoded.Logos) do
                if not seen[id] then take(id) end
            end
        end)
    end

    -- Guarda (crea o reemplaza) un logo ya saneado
    function C.Put(rec)
        local isNew = C.Logos[rec.Id] == nil
        if isNew and #C.Order >= C.Max then return false, "max" end
        C.Logos[rec.Id] = rec
        if isNew then table.insert(C.Order, 1, rec.Id) end
        C.Register(rec)
        return C.Save(), nil
    end

    function C.Remove(id)
        C.Logos[id] = nil
        IconCatalog.Icons[C.Key(id)] = nil
        for i = #C.Order, 1, -1 do
            if C.Order[i] == id then table.remove(C.Order, i) end
        end
        C.Save()
    end

    -- Código para compartir: YYLOGO1:{json}
    function C.Export(rec)
        local copy = table.clone(rec)
        copy.Id = nil
        copy.Created = nil
        return C.Prefix .. HttpService:JSONEncode(copy)
    end

    function C.Import(text)
        local body = tostring(text or ""):match(C.Prefix .. "(.+)$")
        if not body then return nil end
        local ok, decoded = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(body) end)
        if not ok or type(decoded) ~= "table" then return nil end
        decoded.Id = C.NewId()
        decoded.Created = os.time()
        return C.Sanitize(decoded)
    end

    C.Load()
end

    ThemePalettes.Dark.Secondary = Color3.fromRGB(92, 38, 0)

    ThemePalettes.Dark.Accent = Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 0)

local function BuildAjustesExtras(Window, AutoTabAjustes, getSlidersHidden, setSlidersHidden, getChatCornerMessagesEnabled, setChatCornerMessagesEnabled)
    local page = AutoTabAjustes._ContentParent or AutoTabAjustes.Page

    RowKit.SettingsHeader(page, 74530897423840, "Idioma", "Language", "Idioma de toda la interfaz", "Language of the whole interface")
    RowKit.Segmented(page, {
        { key = "auto", es = "Auto", en = "Auto" },
        { key = "es", es = "Español", en = "Español" },
        { key = "en", es = "English", en = "English" },
    }, YLang.Mode or "auto", function(mode)
        YLang.SetMode(mode)
    end)

    RowKit.SettingsHeader(page, 138141460046805, "Ícono flotante", "Floating icon", "Bloqueá el ícono para que no se mueva", "Lock the icon so it can't be moved")
    AutoTabAjustes:CreateToggle("Freeze Icono", "Freeze Icon", false, function(state)
        IconoCongelado = state
        if Window.Dragon and Window.Dragon.Draggable then
            Window.Dragon.Draggable = not state
        end
        if state then
            AutoTabAjustes:CreateLabel("Icono congelado (No se puede mover)", "Icon frozen (Cannot be moved)", 11)
        end
    end)

    RowKit.SettingsHeader(page, 110031536363644, "Chat", "Chat", "Avisos del chat en la esquina de la pantalla", "Chat notices in the screen corner")
    AutoTabAjustes:CreateToggle(
        "Mensajes del Chat en esquina",
        "Chat Corner Messages",
        getChatCornerMessagesEnabled(),
        function(state)
            setChatCornerMessagesEnabled(state)
            SavedConfig.ChatCornerMessages = state
            SaveConfig()
        end
    )

    RowKit.SettingsHeader(page, 72126043741813, "Sonidos", "Sounds", "Sonidos de clic según el tema activo", "Click sounds based on the active theme")
    AutoTabAjustes:CreateToggle("Sonidos Dinámicos", "Dynamic Sounds", DynamicClickSoundsEnabled, function(state)
        DynamicClickSoundsEnabled = state
        AutoTabAjustes:CreateLabel(
            state and " Sonidos por tema activados" or " Sonidos desactivados",
            state and " Theme sounds enabled"      or " Sounds disabled",
            11
        )
    end)

    RowKit.SettingsHeader(page, 76854672555792, "Sliders", "Sliders", "Mostrá u ocultá todos los sliders", "Show or hide every slider")
    AutoTabAjustes:CreateToggle("Ocultar Sliders", "Hide Sliders", getSlidersHidden(), function(state)
        setSlidersHidden(state)
        for _, obj in ipairs(Window.ScreenGui:GetDescendants()) do
            if obj:GetAttribute("IsSliderHolder") then
                obj.Visible = not state
            end
        end
        SavedConfig.HideSliders = state
        SaveConfig()
    end)

    RowKit.SettingsHeader(page, 92038302677245, "Plataforma", "Platform", "Ajusta el tamaño de la ventana al dispositivo", "Fits the window size to your device")
    RowKit.Segmented(page, {
        { key = "Auto",   es = "Auto",  en = "Auto"   },
        { key = "PC",     es = "PC",    en = "PC"     },
        { key = "Mobile", es = "Móvil", en = "Mobile" },
    }, SavedConfig.PlatformMode or "Auto", function(mode)
        SavedConfig.PlatformMode = mode
        SaveConfig()
        Window.UpdateWindowSize()
    end)

    RowKit.SettingsHeader(page, 91328661401828, "Estilo de Toggle Flotante", "Floating Toggle Style",
        "Se aplica al instante, incluso a los toggles que ya tenés flotando",
        "Applies instantly, even to toggles you already have floating")
    RowKit.Segmented(page, {
        { key = "Pill",   es = "Píldora", en = "Pill"   },
        { key = "Circle", es = "Círculo", en = "Circle" },
    }, SavedConfig.FloatingToggleStyle or "Pill", function(styleValue)
        SavedConfig.FloatingToggleStyle = styleValue
        SaveConfig()
        Window.ApplyFloatingStyle()
    end)
    FloatingPillV5.Studio.BuildEntry(page, Window)

    RowKit.SettingsHeader(page, 131461432895733, "Estilo de pestañas", "Tab Style",
        "Por defecto usa la pestaña original. El carrusel es opcional.",
        "The original tab layout is the default. The carousel is optional.")
    RowKit.Segmented(page, {
        { key = "Original", es = "Originales", en = "Original" },
        { key = "Carousel", es = "Carrusel",   en = "Carousel" },
    }, SavedConfig.TabIconLayout or "Original", function(layoutValue)
        if Window.SetTabIconLayout then
            Window:SetTabIconLayout(layoutValue)
        end
    end)

    RowKit.SettingsHeader(page, 81463911885004, "Apariencia", "Appearance")
    RowKit.InfoCard(page, {
        { "Versión", "Version", "v28 ULTRA MEJORADA", "v28 ULTRA IMPROVED" },
        { "Chat Fullscreen", "Chat Fullscreen", "ACTIVO", "ACTIVE" },
        { "Colores Dinámicos", "Dynamic Colors", "ACTIVO", "ACTIVE" },
    })

    -- ==================== OPTIMIZACIÓN ====================
    RowKit.SettingsHeader(page, "⚡", "Optimización", "Optimization",
        "Para equipos que no aguantan el script: apagá lo que da lag. Todo se guarda y se puede volver atrás.",
        "For devices that can't handle the script: turn off what causes lag. Everything is saved and reversible.")

    PerfOpt.Hooks.NoTextEffects = function()
        if Window.SetTextEffect then Window:SetTextEffect(Window.CurrentTextEffect or "Off") end
    end
    PerfOpt.Hooks.StaticBackground = function(on)
        local video = Window.BackgroundVideo
        if video then
            pcall(function()
                if on then video:Pause() elseif video.Visible then video:Play() end
            end)
        end
    end
    PerfOpt.Hooks.LiteShaders = function(on)
        local overdrive = Window.Shaders and Window.Shaders.Overdrive
        if not overdrive then return end
        if on then
            local current = overdrive.GetQuality()
            if current ~= "Lite" then PerfOpt.PrevQuality = current end
            overdrive.SetQuality("Lite")
        else
            overdrive.SetQuality(PerfOpt.PrevQuality or "Balanced")
            PerfOpt.PrevQuality = nil
        end
    end
    PerfOpt.Hooks.NoShaders = function(on)
        if on and Window.Shaders then Window.Shaders.Restore() end
    end
    -- al iniciar: shaders en Lite si quedó guardado (el resto ya se respeta solo)
    if PerfOpt.Flags.LiteShaders and Window.Shaders and Window.Shaders.Overdrive.GetQuality() ~= "Lite" then
        pcall(PerfOpt.Hooks.LiteShaders, true)
    end

    local perfToggles = {}
    local perfOrder = {}
    local function perfToggle(key, es, en)
        table.insert(perfOrder, key)
        perfToggles[key] = AutoTabAjustes:CreateToggle(es, en, PerfOpt.Flags[key], function(state)
            PerfOpt.Set(key, state)
        end)
    end

    AutoTabAjustes:CreateLabel("Interfaz", "Interface", 12)
    perfToggle("NoAnimations", "Sin animaciones de interfaz", "No interface animations")
    perfToggle("NoTextEffects", "Sin efectos de texto", "No text effects")
    perfToggle("StaticBackground", "Fondo animado quieto", "Static animated background")
    perfToggle("NoLogoAnim", "Logo flotante sin animación", "Floating logo without animation")
    perfToggle("NoHomeAvatar", "Avatar de Inicio quieto", "Still Home avatar")
    perfToggle("NoDecorAnim", "Título, banner y vistas previas quietos", "Still title, banner and previews")
    perfToggle("NoUISounds", "Sin sonidos de clic", "No click sounds")

    AutoTabAjustes:CreateLabel("Shaders", "Shaders", 12)
    perfToggle("LiteShaders", "Shaders en modo ligero", "Shaders in lite mode")
    perfToggle("NoPostFX", "Sin desenfoque, profundidad ni rayos", "No blur, depth of field or sun rays")
    perfToggle("NoShaders", "Shaders apagados (también al iniciar)", "Shaders off (also on start)")

    AutoTabAjustes:CreateLabel("Juego", "Game", 12)
    perfToggle("NoShadows", "Sin sombras del juego", "No game shadows")
    perfToggle("NoParticles", "Sin partículas, humo ni fuego", "No particles, smoke or fire")
    perfToggle("MapBoost", "Mapa liviano (sin texturas ni materiales)", "Light map (no textures or materials)")
    perfToggle("LowGraphics", "Gráficos al mínimo", "Lowest graphics")
    perfToggle("FpsCap30", "Limitar a 30 FPS (ahorro de batería)", "Cap at 30 FPS (battery saver)")
    AutoTabAjustes:CreateLabel(
        "Gráficos al mínimo y el límite de FPS dependen de tu executor: si no los permite, no hacen nada.",
        "Lowest graphics and the FPS cap depend on your executor: if it doesn't allow them, they do nothing.",
        10
    )

    local function perfSetAll(value)
        -- los sonidos se silencian primero y se devuelven al final, para no disparar 15 clics juntos
        PerfOpt.Flags.NoUISounds = true
        for _, key in ipairs(perfOrder) do
            if key ~= "NoUISounds" and PerfOpt.Flags[key] ~= value then
                PerfOpt.Set(key, value)
            end
            if perfToggles[key] then perfToggles[key].SetValue(value) end
        end
        PerfOpt.Set("NoUISounds", value)
    end
    AutoTabAjustes:CreateButton("⚡ Modo rendimiento máximo", "⚡ Maximum performance mode", function()
        perfSetAll(true)
    end)
    AutoTabAjustes:CreateButton("Volver todo a la normalidad", "Restore everything to normal", function()
        perfSetAll(false)
    end)
end

_G.YinYang = {}
local YinYang = _G.YinYang
YinYang.__index = YinYang

-- ===== KIT DE VENTANAS (para que el script no arme GUIs a mano) =====
-- El script pide las piezas (pantalla, tarjeta, texto, chip, barra, gráfico, arrastre...) y la librería las crea
-- con el tema activo. Cada pieza lleva su rol de color (atributos ThemeRole / ThemeTextRole / ThemeImageRole) y
-- las pantallas creadas con Kit.Screen se vuelven a pintar solas cuando cambiás de tema (Window:SetTheme).
-- Roles: Background, Secondary, AccentOff, Text, TextDim, Stroke, Accent, AccentText (texto sobre Accent).
YinYang.Kit = {Roots = {}, ThemeCallbacks = {},
    OK = Color3.fromRGB(95, 222, 145), ERR = Color3.fromRGB(255, 98, 98), WARN = Color3.fromRGB(240, 190, 60)}
do
    local Kit = YinYang.Kit
    local FALLBACK = {
        Background = Color3.fromRGB(16, 16, 18), Secondary = Color3.fromRGB(32, 32, 36), AccentOff = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 66),
        Text = Color3.fromRGB(245, 245, 248), TextDim = Color3.fromRGB(165, 165, 175), Stroke = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 160),
        Accent = Color3.fromRGB(235, 235, 240),
    }
    -- colores del tema activo (o los de reserva si todavía no hay ventana)
    function Kit.Palette()
        local active = Theme or ThemePalettes["Dark"] or FALLBACK
        local out = {}
        for key, value in pairs(FALLBACK) do
            local themed = active[key]
            out[key] = (typeof(themed) == "Color3") and themed or value
        end
        out.AccentText = (typeof(active.AccentText) == "Color3") and active.AccentText or getContrastColor(out.Accent)
        return out
    end
    function Kit.Contrast(color) return getContrastColor(color) end
    function Kit.Tween(obj, t, props, style, dir)
        local tw = TweenService:Create(obj, TweenInfo.new(t, style or Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, dir or Enum.EasingDirection.Out), props)
        tw:Play()
        return tw
    end
    -- crea una instancia; roles = {bg = "Background", text = "Text", image = "Accent", stroke = "Stroke"}
    -- le pone roles a algo que ya existe y lo pinta ya con el tema activo
    function Kit.Role(obj, roles)
        if not (obj and roles) then return obj end
        local p = Kit.Palette()
        if roles.bg then
            obj:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", roles.bg)
            if obj:IsA("UIStroke") then obj.Color = p[roles.bg] or obj.Color else pcall(function() obj.BackgroundColor3 = p[roles.bg] or obj.BackgroundColor3 end) end
        end
        if roles.text then
            obj:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", roles.text)
            pcall(function() obj.TextColor3 = p[roles.text] or obj.TextColor3 end)
        end
        if roles.image then
            obj:SetAttribute("ThemeImageRole", roles.image)
            pcall(function() obj.ImageColor3 = p[roles.image] or obj.ImageColor3 end)
        end
        return obj
    end
    function Kit.New(class, props, parent, roles)
        local obj = mk(class, props or {}, nil)
        if roles then Kit.Role(obj, roles) end
        if parent then obj.Parent = parent end
        return obj
    end
    function Kit.Corner(obj, radius) return mk("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius or 8)}, obj) end
    function Kit.Stroke(obj, role, thickness, transparency)
        return Kit.New("UIStroke", {Thickness = thickness or 1.2, Transparency = transparency or 0.5, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border}, obj, {bg = role or "Stroke"})
    end
    function Kit.Pad(obj, top, right, bottom, left)
        return mk("UIPadding", {PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, top or 0), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, right or top or 0),
            PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, bottom or top or 0), PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, left or right or top or 0)}, obj)
    end
    function Kit.List(obj, padding, horizontal)
        return mk("UIListLayout", {Padding = UDim.new(0, padding or 6), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
            FillDirection = horizontal and Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal or Enum.FillDirection.Vertical}, obj)
    end
    -- pantalla propia (se borra la anterior con el mismo nombre) que sigue el tema
    function Kit.Screen(name, displayOrder, parentOverride)
        local parent = parentOverride or LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
        local old = parent:FindFirstChild(name)
        if old then old:Destroy() end
        local gui = mk("ScreenGui", {Name = name, ResetOnSpawn = false, DisplayOrder = displayOrder or 50}, parent)
        Kit.Roots[#Kit.Roots + 1] = gui
        return gui
    end
    -- tarjeta: fondo del tema, esquinas y borde
    function Kit.Card(parent, props, strokeRole)
        props = props or {}
        if props.BackgroundTransparency == nil then props.BackgroundTransparency = 0.08 end
        props.BorderSizePixel = 0
        local radius, role = props.Radius or 16, props.Role or "Background"
        props.Radius, props.Role = nil, nil
        local card = Kit.New("Frame", props, parent, {bg = role})
        Kit.Corner(card, radius)
        Kit.Stroke(card, strokeRole or "Accent", 1.4, 0.5)
        return card
    end
    -- texto con su rol de color
    function Kit.Label(parent, props, role)
        props = props or {}
        if props.BackgroundTransparency == nil then props.BackgroundTransparency = 1 end
        props.Font = props.Font or Enum.Font.GothamBold
        props.TextSize = props.TextSize or 12
        return Kit.New("TextLabel", props, parent, {text = role or "Text"})
    end
    -- chip redondeado (fondo AccentOff por defecto) con UIScale para el "pop"
    function Kit.Chip(parent, props, bgRole, textRole)
        props = props or {}
        props.Size = props.Size or UDim2.fromOffset(0, 22)
        if props.AutomaticSize == nil then props.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X end
        props.Font = props.Font or Enum.Font.GothamBlack
        props.TextSize = props.TextSize or 11
        props.BorderSizePixel = 0
        local chip = Kit.New("TextLabel", props, parent, {bg = bgRole or "AccentOff", text = textRole or "Text"})
        Kit.Corner(chip, 999)
        Kit.Pad(chip, 0, 9, 0, 9)
        local scale = mk("UIScale", {Scale = 1}, chip)
        return chip, scale
    end
    function Kit.Pop(scale, from)
        scale.Scale = from or 1.25
        Kit.Tween(scale, 0.25, {Scale = 1}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
    end
    -- barra de progreso: devuelve el fondo y el relleno
    function Kit.Bar(parent, props, fillRole, trackRole)
        props = props or {}
        props.BorderSizePixel = 0
        local track = Kit.New("Frame", props, parent, {bg = trackRole or "Secondary"})
        Kit.Corner(track, 99)
        local fill = Kit.New("Frame", {Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1), BorderSizePixel = 0}, track, {bg = fillRole or "Accent"})
        Kit.Corner(fill, 99)
        return track, fill
    end
    -- gráfico de barras verticales (count barras); Kit.SetBars(bars, valores, máximo)
    function Kit.Bars(parent, count, role)
        local list = {}
        for i = 1, count do
            local b = Kit.New("Frame", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1), Position = UDim2.new((i - 1) / count, 0, 1, 0),
                Size = UDim2.new(1 / count, -1, 0, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 0.5, BorderSizePixel = 0}, parent, {bg = role or "Accent"})
            list[i] = b
        end
        return list
    end
    function Kit.SetBars(bars, samples, top)
        local count = #bars
        top = math.max(top or 1, 1)
        for i, b in ipairs(bars) do
            local s = samples[i - (count - #samples)]
            local h = s and math.clamp(s / top, 0.05, 1) or 0.05
            b.Size = UDim2.new(1 / count, -1, h, 0)
            b.BackgroundTransparency = s and (0.55 - 0.45 * h) or 0.85
        end
    end
    -- arrastrar target desde handle; devuelve una función para desconectar
    function Kit.Drag(handle, target)
        local dragging, startPos, startInput = false, nil, nil
        handle.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                dragging, startPos, startInput = true, target.Position, input.Position
            end
        end)
        local c1 = UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
            if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
                local d = input.Position - startInput
                target.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + d.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + d.Y)
            end
        end)
        local c2 = UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then dragging = false end
        end)
        local function disconnect() c1:Disconnect() c2:Disconnect() end
        handle.Destroying:Connect(disconnect)
        return disconnect
    end
    -- aparece con un rebote chico
    function Kit.Appear(obj, from)
        local scale = obj:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale") or mk("UIScale", {Scale = from or 0.9}, obj)
        scale.Scale = from or 0.9
        Kit.Tween(scale, 0.3, {Scale = 1}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
        return scale
    end
    -- algo que no es un color de rol (degradados, contrastes): se llama al cambiar de tema con la paleta nueva
    function Kit.OnTheme(fn)
        Kit.ThemeCallbacks[#Kit.ThemeCallbacks + 1] = fn
        -- devuelve una función para sacarlo (cuando se cierra la ventana)
        return function()
            local i = table.find(Kit.ThemeCallbacks, fn)
            if i then table.remove(Kit.ThemeCallbacks, i) end
        end
    end

    -- ===== crear y pintar por rol automáticamente =====
    -- Kit.Make(clase, props, parent): igual que Instance.new + props, pero lo crea la librería y, si un color es
    -- uno del tema activo (fondo, texto, acento...), le pone ese rol para que siga al tema. Las ScreenGui quedan
    -- registradas para repintarse. No cambia ningún otro valor por defecto.
    local ORDER = {
        bg = {"Background", "Secondary", "AccentOff", "Accent", "Stroke", "Text", "TextDim"},
        text = {"Text", "TextDim", "Accent", "AccentText"},
        stroke = {"Accent", "Stroke", "Text", "TextDim", "Secondary", "Background", "AccentOff"},
        image = {"Accent", "Text", "TextDim"},
    }
    local function colorKey(c)
        return math.floor(c.R * 255 + 0.5) * 65536 + math.floor(c.G * 255 + 0.5) * 256 + math.floor(c.B * 255 + 0.5)
    end
    local function roleFor(kind, color, p)
        if typeof(color) ~= "Color3" then return nil end
        local k = colorKey(color)
        for _, role in ipairs(ORDER[kind]) do
            local c = p[role]
            if typeof(c) == "Color3" and colorKey(c) == k then return role end
        end
        return nil
    end
    function Kit.Tag(obj, p)
        p = p or Kit.Palette()
        if obj:IsA("UIStroke") then
            if not obj:GetAttribute("ThemeRole") then
                local r = roleFor("stroke", obj.Color, p)
                if r then obj:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", r) end
            end
            return obj
        end
        if not obj:IsA("GuiObject") then return obj end
        if not obj:GetAttribute("ThemeRole") and obj.BackgroundTransparency < 1 then
            local r = roleFor("bg", obj.BackgroundColor3, p)
            if r then obj:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", r) end
        end
        if (obj:IsA("TextLabel") or obj:IsA("TextButton") or obj:IsA("TextBox")) and not obj:GetAttribute("ThemeTextRole") then
            local r = roleFor("text", obj.TextColor3, p)
            if r then obj:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", r) end
        end
        if (obj:IsA("ImageLabel") or obj:IsA("ImageButton")) and not obj:GetAttribute("ThemeImageRole") and obj.Image ~= "" then
            local r = roleFor("image", obj.ImageColor3, p)
            if r then obj:SetAttribute("ThemeImageRole", r) end
        end
        return obj
    end
    function Kit.Make(class, props, parent)
        local obj = Instance.new(class)
        for k, v in pairs(props or {}) do obj[k] = v end
        if class == "ScreenGui" then
            Kit.Roots[#Kit.Roots + 1] = obj
        elseif props then
            -- sin props (se configura después) no se marca acá: lo hace Kit.Adopt al terminar la ventana
            pcall(Kit.Tag, obj)
        end
        if parent then obj.Parent = parent end
        return obj
    end
    -- una ventana ya armada (con Instance.new): le pone los roles a todo lo que tenga colores del tema y la registra
    function Kit.Adopt(root, p)
        p = p or Kit.Palette()
        for _, obj in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do pcall(Kit.Tag, obj, p) end
        pcall(Kit.Tag, root, p)
        local gui = root:IsA("ScreenGui") and root or root:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("ScreenGui")
        if gui and not table.find(Kit.Roots, gui) then Kit.Roots[#Kit.Roots + 1] = gui end
        return root
    end
    -- lo llama Window:SetTheme
    function Kit._Repaint(palette)
        local alive = {}
        for _, root in ipairs(Kit.Roots) do
            if root.Parent then
                alive[#alive + 1] = root
                for _, obj in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do swapThemeColor(obj, palette) end
            end
        end
        Kit.Roots = alive
        local p = Kit.Palette()
        for _, fn in ipairs(Kit.ThemeCallbacks) do pcall(fn, p) end
    end
end

-- ===== COMPONENTES LISTOS (las ventanas que usa el script) =====
-- El script ya no arma ventanas: pide una (Kit.Window, Kit.Meter, Kit.Hud, Kit.HostWindow, Kit.TopbarButton) y le
-- agrega piezas (sección, texto, botones, grilla, lista, campos, mosaicos, barra...). Todo sigue el tema activo.
do
    local Kit = YinYang.Kit
    local function Label(parent, props, role) return Kit.Label(parent, props, role) end
    local function Btn(parent, props, bgRole, textRole)
        props.AutoButtonColor = false
        props.Font = props.Font or Enum.Font.GothamBold
        props.TextSize = props.TextSize or 12
        props.BorderSizePixel = 0
        return Kit.New("TextButton", props, parent, {bg = bgRole or "Secondary", text = textRole or "Text"})
    end
    -- botón que se prende/apaga (prendido = acento)
    local function onOff(button, on, offText)
        Kit.Role(button, {bg = on and "Accent" or "Secondary", text = on and "AccentText" or (offText or "Text")})
    end
    Kit.SetOn = onOff

    -- arrastre de una ventana desde su barra (con candado opcional)
    local function dragFrom(handle, target, isLocked)
        local dragging, startPos, startInput = false, nil, nil
        handle.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if isLocked and isLocked() then return end
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                dragging, startPos, startInput = true, target.Position, input.Position
            end
        end)
        local c1 = UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
            if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
                local d = input.Position - startInput
                target.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + d.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + d.Y)
            end
        end)
        local c2 = UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then dragging = false end
        end)
        target.Destroying:Connect(function() c1:Disconnect() c2:Disconnect() end)
    end
    Kit.DragFrom = dragFrom

    -- ============ piezas que se agregan a un contenedor (ventana o caja) ============
    local Widgets = {}
    Widgets.__index = Widgets
    local function container(frame, gap)
        return setmetatable({Frame = frame, Order = 0, Gap = gap or 8}, Widgets)
    end
    function Widgets:_next() self.Order = self.Order + 1 return self.Order end
    -- título chico de sección
    function Widgets:Section(text)
        return Label(self.Frame, {LayoutOrder = self:_next(), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14), TextSize = 10,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Text = text}, "TextDim")
    end
    -- texto (o = {Dim, Height, Wrap, Rich, Size, Font, Align})
    function Widgets:Text(text, o)
        o = o or {}
        return Label(self.Frame, {LayoutOrder = self:_next(), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, o.Height or 16), TextSize = o.Size or 12,
            Font = o.Font or Enum.Font.GothamMedium, TextWrapped = o.Wrap == true, RichText = o.Rich == true,
            TextXAlignment = o.Align or Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextYAlignment = o.Wrap and Enum.TextYAlignment.Top or Enum.TextYAlignment.Center,
            Text = text or ""}, o.Dim and "TextDim" or "Text")
    end
    -- caja secundaria con sus propias piezas
    function Widgets:Box(o)
        o = o or {}
        local box = Kit.New("Frame", {LayoutOrder = self:_next(), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
            BackgroundTransparency = o.Transparency or 0.25, BorderSizePixel = 0}, self.Frame, {bg = "Secondary"})
        Kit.Corner(box, o.Radius or 12)
        Kit.Pad(box, o.PadY or 8, o.PadX or 10, o.PadY or 8, o.PadX or 10)
        Kit.List(box, o.Gap or 6)
        return container(box, o.Gap or 6)
    end
    -- fila "nombre ........ valor" (devuelve el valor)
    function Widgets:Row(name, o)
        o = o or {}
        local r = Kit.New("Frame", {LayoutOrder = self:_next(), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 16), BackgroundTransparency = 1}, self.Frame)
        Label(r, {Size = UDim2.new(o.Split or 0.45, 0, 1, 0), Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, TextSize = 11,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Text = name}, "TextDim")
        return Label(r, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1 - (o.Split or 0.45), 0, 1, 0),
            TextSize = 11, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, Text = "-"}, "Text")
    end
    -- barra de progreso con textos a los costados (arriba) o abajo
    function Widgets:Progress(o)
        o =
